data.narrative:
Gallatin AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peer companies across the sector—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $15M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, implies a valuation of $38M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects significant stage and maturity variation within the Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $32M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $369M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects the highly heterogeneous comparables set; Gallatin's relative position within peer stage distribution remains a critical uncertainty. Capital efficiency and product-market progress in the near term will be essential to validate positioning within this range.
